content.title: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation - Reviewers
content.note: Report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by the experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year (calls conducted during development of guidelines up to and including 2023).

Declarations: Ongoing research funding from public and/or not-for-profit organisations (which started in 2023 or continues in 2023).
Fresenius Stiftung (listed under ongoing research funding).
Payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, travel funding related to these activities.
Membership or affiliation in political or advocacy groups working in the field of cardiology. Member of DGK, HRS, EHRA, ESC.
Direct personal payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc.
Travel and meeting support from healthcare industry, independent of the above activities.

Direct financial interest in healthcare, media, education companies or in companies related to (suppliers), or in competition with the ESC and its mission to reduce the burden of cardiovascular disease.
Education - Author on section in major Danish textbook (Medicinsk Kompendium).
Employment (including part time) in healthcare industry during the year for which declaring: Swiss Re (insurance company) : Consultancy.
Membership or affiliation in political or advocacy groups working in the field of cardiology. Danish Heart Foundation and Danish Society of Cardiology.
